description: We will gnaw the way through space and future for we are SpaceBobru!
summary: We have developed a survival strategy game centred on building a base on the Moon. The game allows you to control six different modules, a rover and three crew members, each of whom is better at a specific task than the other two. The game’s key features include: a system of choices requiring players to make carefully considered decisions to minimise damage and maximise benefits in crisis situations; and a focus on realism – a mission based on the real-life Pragyan rover and the Solar Particle Event of 18–19 January 2026, which serves as the final test for players. The project fits the challenge because its pixel art style, pleasant soundtrack and intuitive interface will help even children aged 7–12 to immerse themselves in the experience of surviving on the Moon without any difficulty.
details:
• The game shows the younger generation just how important it is to be able to make difficult decisions during space missions, in situations where things do not go to plan and spiral out of control.
    • Language: C#
    • Engine: Unity 6 (Universal Render Pipeline 2D)
    • IDE: Visual Studio 2026
    • Version control: Git + GitHub (with Git LFS for assets)
    • Graphics: Aseprite (pixel art and animation)
    • UI text: TextMeshPro
